title: Flat convergence implies weak convergence (Simon 7.2, 'if' part)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and T, T_j ∈ D_n(U) (j ∈ ℕ) arbitrary currents. Suppose that for every open W ⊂⊂ U (W open, closure W compact and contained in U) the flat pseudodistance d_W(T_j, T) = flatDistance W (T_j) T = inf{M_W(S) + M_W(R) : R ∈ D_{n+1}(U), S ∈ D_n(U) integer multiplicity, T_j − T = ∂R + S} tends to 0 in [0, ∞]. Then T_j ⇀ T, i.e. T_j(ω) → T(ω) for every ω ∈ D^n(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → Tendsto (fun j => flatDistance W (Tj j) T) atTop (𝓝 0)) → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T
